name: Shag do propasti
source:
How many times can you live through the exact same week before it stops meaning anything?

For Semyon, Sovyonok has long become a disgustingly familiar scenario. The same faces. The same events. The same conversations. No matter what he does, in seven days everything will start over, and the camp will greet him again as if nothing happened.

Over time, the fear of making a mistake disappears. Then, the feeling of guilt. And when the consequences are erased anyway, it is easy to stop seeing the people around you as human.

But one day, the next cycle ends differently.

Semyon comes to his senses at night in front of the closed gates of Sovyonok. There is no bus. The camp has changed. Its residents behave completely differently from what he is used to.

And, worst of all, they remember.

Now every decision has consequences, death has ceased to be a convenient reset button, and old actions finally begin to catch up with the one who is used to considering himself unpunished.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3798533381]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一模一样的一周究竟要重复经历多少遍，才会彻底变得毫无意义？

对谢苗而言，“小猫头鹰”夏令营早已变成了一出熟稔到令人作呕的剧本。同样的面孔，同样的事件，同样的对话。无论他做什么，七天之后一切都会重头来过，夏令营又会像无事发生过一样重新迎接他的到来。

久而久之，对犯错的恐惧消失了，紧接着连罪恶感也荡然无存。既然一切后果终将被一笔勾销，人便很容易不再把身边的人当作活生生的人来看待。

直到某一天，最新一轮循环迎来了截然不同的终局。

谢苗在夜色中苏醒，面前是“小猫头鹰”夏令营紧闭的大门。公交车不见了踪影，营地变了模样，里面每个人的言行举止也都与他习惯的完全不同。

而最可怕的是——他们全都记得。

如今每一个决定都伴随着真实的后果，死亡不再是随手可用的重置按钮；对于这个早已习惯逍遥法外的人而言，昔日犯下的恶果终于开始一一找上门来。
